content: क्रतुः [कृ-कतु <ls>Uṇ. 1. 77</ls>] .²1 A sacrifice; क्रतोरशेषेण फलेन युज्यताम् <ls>R. 3. 65</ls>; शतं क्रतूनामपविघ्नमाप सः <ls n="R.">3. 38</ls>; <ls>M. 1. 4</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 79</ls>. .²2 An epithet of Viṣṇu. .²3 One of the ten Prajāpatis; क्रतुं प्रजापतिमब्रुवन् <ls>Maitr. Up. 2. 3</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 35</ls>. .²4 Intelligence, talent. .²5 Power, ability. .²6 Plan, design, purpose; क्रतो स्मर कृतं स्मर <ls>Īśop. 17</ls>; <ls>Bṛ. Up. 5. 15. 1</ls>. .²7 Resolution, determination; यत्क्रतुर्भवति तत्कर्म कुरुते <ls>Bṛ. Up. 4. 4. 5</ls>. .²8 Desire, will. .²9 Fitness, adequacy, efficiency. .²10 Deliberation, consultation. .²11 Inspiration. .²12 Enlightenment. .²13 Offering, worship; कामस्याप्तिं जगतः प्रतिष्ठां क्रतोरानन्त्यमभयस्य पारम् <ls>Kaṭh. 1. 2. 11</ls>; Personified, as married to क्रिया and father of 60000 वालखिल्यs; क्रतोरपि क्रिया भार्या वालखिल्यानसूयत <ls>Bhāg. 4. 1. 39</ls>. .²14 An Aśvameḍha sacrifice (these senses are mostly Vedic). .²15 The month Āṣāḍha. .²16 Excess of fondness or liking. .²17 An organ [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>Gr.</lang> {%kratos%}; <lang>Zend.</lang> {%khratu%}].
